# Registrations {#registrations .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Section 3
:::

::: notes
Section three is about the other thing that the OSF keeps: registrations, which freeze a plan with a date on it before the result is known. An archive freezes materials and a registration freezes a plan, and the two dates, of the plan and of the result, are what let a reader tell an analysis planned in advance from one chosen after the fact. We look at what a registration is and at one that did its job in one of the workshop's case studies, then at the preregistration of the SCORE robustness study, and last at the two templates that a reanalysis can use.
:::
